subject: Drata SOW and pricing clarifications
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Trent <olivia.trent@drata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: SOW scope & seat-pricing question

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the quick call this morning. Following up with the items we discussed so we have them on record as we prep procurement:

- Can you confirm whether the SOW is seat-based or org-wide licensing for the features listed on page 2? The draft SOW we pulled has both a per-seat line and an enterprise line and I want to be sure which one you intend to invoice.
- There are two optional add-ons (API rate limit increase and annual evidence bundling). Can we get line-item pricing for both and the discount tiers at 250/500/1000 seats?
- We need a standard timeline for onboarding (kickoff -> SOC evidence handoff -> 30-day audit readiness). If you can drop those milestones in the SOW it will help our security team sign off faster.

I'm attaching the Redwood procurement checklist so your ops team knows the PO/contract path. Also accept if you can send a DocuSign link for a clean SOW + Order Form once we agree pricing.

Thanks — happy to hop on another 15 if that's easier.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
[Attachment: RDW_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (Excel, 54KB)]

From: Olivia Trent <olivia.trent@drata.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: sales-ops@drata.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: SOW scope & seat-pricing question

Sean —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached is an updated SOW (v3) that consolidates the licensing model to per-seat licensing by default, with a single enterprise alternative if you prefer committed throughput instead of seats. Highlights:

- Licensing: Default per-seat with a 10% off list at 250 seats, 15% at 500 seats, and 20% at 1000+ seats. Enterprise committed throughput pricing is available on request (adds a 60-day forecast cadence).
- Add-ons: API rate increase is priced as a monthly block; evidence bundling (annual) is a one-time line item — both are listed on page 5 with examples.
- Onboarding milestones: added Kickoff (week 0), Implementation sprint (weeks 1–4), Evidence delivery (week 6), Audit readiness check (week 8).

I'm including the SOW as Drata_SOW_v3.pdf. If that looks good to you I'll ask Ops to prepare an Order Form and send a DocuSign link that covers the PO number field you requested.

DocuSign link (will be live after internal approval): https://app.docusign.com/SEALINK/abcdef

Regards,
Olivia Trent
Sr. Commercial Operations
Drata Inc.
[Attachment: Drata_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 298KB)]

Forwarding Olivia's updated SOW (attached) — skim and tell me if you see any legal or compliance red flags before I ask them to send the DocuSign. Key asks for us:

1) Confirm we are comfortable with per-seat by default. Our forecast is ~320 active seats year 1, so the 15% tier should apply but I want Procurement to lock that.
2) Evidence bundling as a one-time fee — Monica, will Security be okay with the described delivery cadence (evidence delivery by week 6, audit readiness week 8)?
3) Marissa — any gotchas in the Order Form terms (liability cap, data retention clause)? If you can pencil in minimal redlines that Ops can accept, that will speed this.

Quote from Olivia included for context: 

> Licensing: Default per-seat with a 10% off list at 250 seats, 15% at 500 seats, and 20% at 1000+ seats. Enterprise committed throughput pricing is available on request (adds a 60-day forecast cadence).

Also attaching our draft PO for internal review: [Attachment: Redwood_PO_draft_20260513.pdf].

-Sean

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Initial: SOW scope & seat-pricing question

Thanks for the ping, Sean. Quick notes after a read through the SOW v3 and the draft PO: 

- Per-seat model is fine; 320 seats sits between the 250/500 tiers so Ops should lock the 15% band as a negotiation floor. Confirm with Olivia that the 15% applies retroactively to all seats if we cross 500 mid-contract (we prefer a true tiered volume discount rather than a cliff).
- Onboarding milestones are reasonable. Week 6 evidence delivery is acceptable provided they commit to the evidence format (PDF + export of control IDs). Ask them to list the specific control mappings so our audit team doesn't spend cycles chasing definitions.
- Data retention clause: flag to legal — the draft has a 13-month retention default. Suggest we change to 9 months with the option to extend for specific evidence sets. Marissa, can you prepare a one-paragraph redline for the data retention term and a short liability cap note?

If Marissa can get those redlines today I'll approve for Ops to request DocuSign. If not, we can aim for a quick legal review tomorrow morning.

Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
monica.patel@redwood.com
